head_policy: Read the exact G6 Draft PR HEAD from Git after push and independent audit; authorization must match that SHA exactly. Never substitute a branch name for a SHA.
main_policy: Fetch origin/main before observation and execution; STOP if it differs from execution_base. HEAD must be a strict descendant of execution_base and the checkout must be clean.
draft_pr_policy: KEEP OPEN/DRAFT through environment observation, independent audit, Research Lead authorization, qualification execution and human review. Merge invalidates this authority. No automatic merge.
run_id_policy: Predeclared before outputs and fixed for this model. Never change in response to output. No retry or repair.
environment_contract_overlay: Keep the v1 environment contract and synthetic v3 plan byte-unchanged. G6 observation records the v3 runtime lock hashes; model identity, processor behavior, software pin, FP16/NONE decoding and raw-before-parse remain unchanged.
authorization_policy: Separate external attestation after independent audit; Research Lead and independent auditor must be distinct. Any HEAD/main/environment/runtime-lock change invalidates approval. The tracked template is inert and is never an authorization artifact.
scientific_contract: Synthetic v3 current contract; parser grammar, images/cases, expected geometry, gate thresholds/rules, no-retry/no-repair and raw-before-parse are unchanged.
